title: Valid Anagram
statement:
Decide whether two words are anagrams of each other.

Contract
- `first` and `second` are non-null and contain only the lowercase letters `a`
  through `z`. Either may be empty.
- Return true exactly when the two words use the same letters the same number of
  times. Order does not matter, so a word is an anagram of itself.
- Words of different lengths are never anagrams.
- Do not mutate the inputs.

Examples
- `isAnagram("listen", "silent")` returns `true`.
- `isAnagram("rat", "car")` returns `false`.
- `isAnagram("aacc", "ccac")` returns `false`.
hints: Two words of different lengths cannot use the same letters the same number of times.
Sorting both words works, but counting each letter avoids the sort entirely.
The alphabet has a fixed size, so one int[26] of counts is enough: add for the first word, subtract for the second, and reject any nonzero count. Intended complexity: O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
inputSyntax: Input: the two words separated by a space, for example: listen silent
